body:
## Change and rationale

The maintainer requested a concise Release-model operation without GitHub PR approving reviews. The adopted Release direction and direct scoped correction are implemented through Design Review r2 and Delivery Review r5: ordinary PR/main CI prepares the real pending release in an isolated checkout, checks its generated source and exact packed runtime, and retains the existing checks and failure behavior. Current-version fixtures follow the tested package. GitHub main protection now requires zero approving reviews while preserving protected PRs, strict ci and administrator enforcement. One protected, candidate-specific release approval remains; generated metadata and hashes are not manual tasks.

The 1.0.0 major intent and notes reflect the approved breaking public changes since 0.5.0. CI-only candidates are explicitly sealed and denied publication approval. Offline intent validation does not claim public version eligibility; hosted preparation still resolves the actual public predecessor and creates a fresh merged-source candidate. Discovery and the archival ledger test receive the bounded compatibility corrections required by the existing CLI/Workflow contracts. No historical record bytes, tests, supported publication safeguards, scripts or public commands were removed or added.

## Exact basis and evidence

Fresh independent code-review-final-r1 approved the entire delivered change after M1 closure; distinct Verify inspected all required authority, subjects, proof, current state and residual limitations. Outcome: branch-ready; workflow-final-verification in governed-final mode. M1 is complete, no open blocker or material finding remains, and current required normative model/plan members match their governing reviews. This report concerns branch readiness for the bounded integration, not publication success.

REL-SR-02/08/09/22/24 map through M1 to actual candidate preparation, metadata/runtime identity checks, source-range preservation, safe failure propagation, historical/current fixture separation and both actual CI graphs. REL-SR-23 is protected by explicit CI-only approval rejection plus unchanged hosted candidate authorization. CLI-SR-10/18/23 and WF-SR-10 map to safe discovery classification, preserved malformed/current rejection and the exact historical catalog disposition with separate current-retirement proof.

Actually observed on engineering source 09c1d089d02ae0ef53a03fe668c91d9c20563b8a:

- `bash scripts/ci.sh --mode pr --base cf6ed229b8314727f47c6dbe387510b4f6f548ac --head 09c1d089d02ae0ef53a03fe668c91d9c20563b8a`: exit 0, all selected checks including required broad_smoke.repo.
- `bash scripts/ci.sh --mode main --base cf6ed229b8314727f47c6dbe387510b4f6f548ac --head 09c1d089d02ae0ef53a03fe668c91d9c20563b8a`: exit 0, all 28 direct checks including final lifecycle validation.

Both ran the existing full candidate verifier, real archives/tarball and supported installed targets. Both checked generated C 776e14d5b5930924d3e36bfc25be2c1036de2ee9; PR candidate 3f9ef36a254b4c236f5cbf8fcba8a1a03014d14274dae6d56cc93cc9aaa61e22 and main candidate b6f5de9ee4ad26e8d8ed3e38914d7ef5b9b0229f37f6a47d38f21bc15c5857cd are separate actual executions. Durable m1-implementation evidence preserves results, original failures and proof limitations. Independent M1 review reran 33 focused candidate/approval/coordination tests successfully. Failed/interrupted earlier attempts are not reused as passes.

The cumulative suffix after 09c1d089 contains only attributable same-change implementation/review/routing evidence and the model author's registration correction to already-approved bytes. No code, configuration, plan, governing model, test or package dependency changed. Therefore actual full execution evidence remains applicable to the final engineering surfaces; newly recorded state is checked directly. Design r2's earlier plan identity is contextual history, with the final plan owned by Delivery r5. Delivery r5's preimplementation code identities are contextual feasibility evidence, superseded for implementation reliance by M1/final Code Review and exact final proof. No old assessment is retargeted to new engineering.

## Impact and limitations

Affected surfaces are CI preparation/selection and validators, generated package identities, current-version test data, safe current-work discovery, retirement-test integration, release intent/guidance and this change's governance records. Existing CLI command/API and persisted record formats remain unchanged: discovery restores the already-adopted boundary, without historical decoding or migration. Published skill content, adapter/installation contracts, dependencies, hosted workflow and publisher implementation are byte-unchanged; real package checks cover their consumption of the new version and prepared bytes. No new dependency, public release command, runner or service is introduced.

Source checkout stayed clean during final execution. Documentation prose enforcement and record-store validation pass; git diff checks pass. The exact remote main remains the checked base. Hosted CI for this branch is not yet observed, and must be reported separately after push. The original pending standing release record is intentional input, not stale generated publication proof; ordinary CI checks the real isolated candidate instead.

No actual 1.0.0 publication, public smoke, customer installation or OIDC write authorization is established. npm publisher configuration intent was maintainer-confirmed; actual authorization is an external execution prerequisite. The release environment still requires the authorized individual's approval and disallows administrator bypass. The next merged candidate must be prepared afresh and approved before publication. Recovery is to revert the bounded integration together, preserving historical evidence and existing release safeguards. No remaining in-scope implementation or unresolved material finding may remain at successful recording.

All passed. Remote repository identity, exact main revision and absence of an existing branch PR were inspected before this assessment. PR may consume this result under the existing user authorization; no external write is claimed here.
